question: Among players with at least 10 goals in 2023-2024, who overperformed their xG by the most (goals minus xG)?
answer:
**Phil Foden (Manchester City)** overperformed his xG by the most in the 2023-2024 Premier League season.

## Top xG overperformers (players with ≥10 goals)

| Rank | Player | Team | Goals | xG | Overperformance (G − xG) |
|------|--------|------|-------|------|--------------------------|
| 1 | **Phil Foden** | Manchester City | 19 | 11.31 | **+7.69** |
| 2 | Michael Olise | Crystal Palace | 10 | 5.69 | +4.31 |
| 3 | Cole Palmer | Chelsea | 22 | 17.83 | +4.17 |
| 4 | Son Heung-min | Tottenham | 17 | 12.98 | +4.02 |
| 5 | Jean-Philippe Mateta | Crystal Palace | 16 | 12.29 | +3.71 |

Phil Foden was the standout, scoring **19 goals from just 11.31 xG** — a clinical finishing overperformance of **+7.69 goals**, comfortably ahead of the rest of the field.

args.sql:
SELECT p.player_name, t.team_name, ps.goals_pss, ps.xg_pss,
       (ps.goals_pss - ps.xg_pss) AS overperformance
FROM player_season_stats ps
JOIN players p ON p.player_id = ps.player_id
JOIN teams t ON t.team_id = ps.team_id
JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id = ps.season_id
WHERE s.competition_id = 1 AND s.season = '2023-2024'
  AND ps.goals_pss >= 10
ORDER BY overperformance DESC
LIMIT 15;
